issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Lecture is inconsistent: the problem statement instructs that the Lecture constructor should follow the attribute order from the UML (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation defines the constructor as Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents). The template only contains a TODO for adding the constructor (no concrete signature). This mismatch between the problem statement's required parameter order and the solution's signature can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and lead to failing exercises or incorrect submissions.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution constructor signature with the UML and the problem instructions. Change the solution constructor to: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and update the constructor body assignments accordingly (this.lectureName = lectureName; this.numberOfInscribedStudents = numberOfInscribedStudents; etc.). Alternatively, if the solution order was intentional, update the problem statement to explicitly document and accept the alternative constructor parameter order so students and tests use the same signature.

issues.description: Constructor parameter ordering mismatch: The problem statement (instruction and UML) expects a Lecture constructor with parameters in the UML attribute order: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. The solution implementation defines the constructor signature as public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents). A student following the problem statement or the UML will expect the constructor parameters in the UML order and may instantiate Lecture incorrectly or be confused when the solution uses a different parameter sequence.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML/instructions. Change the solution constructor signature to: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields in that order. Alternatively, if the different order in the solution was intentional, update the problem statement and UML to explicitly document and allow the solution's parameter ordering so students are not required to follow the UML order.
